accepted.mellan-tee-07-1: the back deck lies in a tree's shade on both photo years, so no photo shows its edge; the September ring stands, and it is level in the laser terrain (deck-ground.mjs)
accepted.mellan-tee-07-2: in a tree's shadow on the 2025 photo, whole on the 2021 one, where the ring fits it; level in the laser terrain (deck-ground.mjs)
accepted.mellan-tee-07-3: the oval Blå deck, plain on both photo years; level in the laser terrain (deck-ground.mjs)

mellan-tee-07-1.reason: A dark tree crown fills the south half of the ring in the same place on both photos, and mown deck shows only in its north part.
mellan-tee-07-1.resolution: a tree's crown overhangs the deck's south half on both photos; the ring is the September trace on the 2025 photo, and the deck under it is level in the laser terrain (deck-ground.mjs), so it goes on under the crown

mellan-tee-08-2.reason: A dark tree crown fills the west half of the ring on both photos (larger with its long April shadow), and open deck with a marker shows only in the east part.
mellan-tee-08-2.resolution: a conifer's crown overhangs the deck's west half on both photos; the deck under the ring is level in the laser terrain (deck-ground.mjs), so it goes on under the crown

cannotTell.mellan-tee-07-2: Tree shadow crosses the south-east half of the ring on 2025 and the deck edge is faint on 2021.
cannotTell.mellan-bunker-01-4: The bunker lies in conifer shade on both photos; little sand is visible and its edge cannot be followed.
